limits: The 333 native server checks ran on the basis JAR. Final changes affect only the listed three client rendering classes; all server entries are byte-identical.
Screenshots are local evidence from the existing registered review client and are excluded from the public source repository.
PMC visual fixtures use real NPC deaths and menu packets; missing armor was equipped to exercise its removal. They do not establish natural spawn equipment probabilities.
Pre-upgrade expired mission contents cannot be reconstructed. The current board is seeded into content history; later boards persist canonical contents.
Existing accepted mission payloads remain unchanged until renewal; the expanded target list applies to newly generated missions.
Natural dawn renewal is an adopted reproduction policy. The original video exact reset time is not confirmed.
Actual multi-client long sessions, live FPS, full video fidelity and publication/import of 0.2.7 distribution archives remain unverified.
